intro.text: An Alethi soldier, once one of Jasnah Kholin's guards, who is handy with a bow and whose sister is a Radiant.

items.text: Beam and Talig are a matched pair, always together on the battlefield. Because Beam was used to taking orders from a woman, Adolin suggested that Colot make him May's second, with Talig as head sergeant, posted on the interior balcony with the Azish archers.
